description: Angular component for autocomplete of data source keys in a widget configuration, including form handling, filtering, and interaction logic.

classes.name: DatasourcesKeyAutocompleteComponent
classes.description: Angular component providing an autocomplete input for data source keys, with form control integration and filtering.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form group and sets up value change subscriptions for filtering keys.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form model.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Method placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form control based on input.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Sets the current value of the input programmatically.

methods.name: clearKey
methods.description: Clears the input key and refocuses the input element.

methods.name: onFocus
methods.description: Updates the validity of the form control on focus.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates the internal model and propagates the change.

methods.name: fetchKeys
methods.description: Fetches and filters keys based on search text.

methods.name: createKeyFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter function for keys based on a query string.

methods.name: allKeys
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of unique data key labels from datasources.
